forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 20, teams completed 3 visits, with 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams active. No zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 14 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 8 areas released and 4 cleared; mines have been found in 1 area. There are 570 suspected or confirmed areas still open.

No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. The access feed shows 7 zones closed. No dossiers or reports were held, and no reports were queried. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P05.

The forecast, made in week 19 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a P10–P90 range of 10–13 mine areas cleared this season and 10–14 zones declared free.
